test_title: PYST 04: SSC JE CE - General Intelligence (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements:**

• Some curlers are serums.

• Some curlers are oils.

**Conclusion (I)**: No oil is serum.

**Conclusion (II): **All oils are serums.
solution:
Given Statements:

• Some curlers are serums.

• Some curlers are oils.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/972c3df2176e9c2f7c6982b837a32356a9ad25eabf0e805ab08353043141945d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No oil is a serum - False (Because, No definite relation is given between oil and serum. There could be an overlap.)

II. All oils are serums - False (Because, No definite relation is given between oil and serum. There is no information to prove that all oils are serums.)

So, neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
